alive.last_commit_message:
fix(cli): an arrow key never lands in a password or a confirmation either (#210)

PR #211 moved the admin name/email and the reset email onto `read -e`. The
other prompts still read without readline, so an arrow key reached the value
as raw escape bytes.

- passwords (admin create, reset, deploy.sh SSH): Left pressed to fix a typo
  in the hidden field stored "\e[D". Typed the same way twice it passed the
  confirm check, and no browser login could ever match it. -s still hides
  the input: readline does not echo while the terminal's echo is off.
- confirmations ([y/N] clean and KB ingestion, 'yes' for purge, INIT in
  deploy.sh): an arrow pressed before the prompt turned "yes" into a cancel.

Checked through a pty on bash 3.2, 4.4, 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3; piped stdin and a
missing /dev/tty behave as before. tests/redamon_admin_test.sh drives the
admin and reset prompts through a pty with early arrows and Left-arrow typo
fixes, and fails on any prompted read in redamon.sh or deploy.sh without -e.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
